title: Sign legibility is arithmetic — Image Wiki

rules.rule: If viewing distance exceeds 6 feet at normal mounting height, minimum character height increases by 1/8 inch per additional foot.
If viewing distance exceeds 20 feet behind a counter, minimum character height is 2 3/8 inches.
rules.evidence: a sign at normal eye level read from 20 feet behind a counter needs characters 2 3/8 inches high

rules.rule: Stroke thickness must not exceed 30% of cap height for visual characters to avoid letter blobs.
rules.evidence: Above roughly 30% of cap height the counters fill in. There is a ceiling as well as a floor.

rules.rule: Contrast compliance requires at least 20 LRV points between text and background, with 30 preferred under 200 lux lighting.
rules.evidence: asks for a difference of at least 20 LRV points between adjacent critical surfaces, with 30 preferred
